name: The First Architect, Aurelius
description: The undying founder of the Under-Barrow, his tall frame half-fused with green-black bronze astrolabes, silver Choir-wires, and lye-white plate. Three centuries of refusing to let his wife Caelia pass have calcified him into a living monument of grief and iron law.

name: Calcified Threshold Warden
description: An ancient mason-guard of the First Architect whose flesh has turned to coarse white memory-salt inside his bronze harness, swinging a plumb-weight in an eternal arc.
